title: Hauntboard
summary: Public message board on Ootle testnet with public threads and encrypted sealed rooms. October 29 public inspection loaded five general threads and a privacy explanation; the deployed page reported runtime 0.46.0. Classic invitations share a key in the URL fragment. The current explanation also describes recipient-specific encrypted invitations, a separate recovery vault and rotation for future messages. Old keys and plaintext cannot be revoked; wallet recovery does not restore room keys, and messages do not authenticate individual authors. Titles, categories, fees, spent-output links, timing and network metadata remain public; accepted posts cannot be edited or deleted through Hauntboard. The October 28 creator update describes SDK/recovery work in PR 3 as not yet deployed; historical test transactions are not fresh acceptance of that upgrade. The recording shows public pages and privacy documentation, with no wallet, private-room access or posting.
cardSummary: Read public Ootle discussions or share encrypted room messages with invitations and separate room-key recovery.
creator: _squared
